sections.title: Declaration
sections.text:
I hereby declare that the work reported in this thesis is entirely original. This
thesis is composed independently by me at the Inter-University Centre for As-
tronomy and Astrophysics, Pune under the supervision of Prof. Sukanta Bose. I
further declare that the subject matter presented in the thesis has not previously
formed the basis for the award of any degree, diploma, membership, associateship,
fellowship, or any other similar title of any University or Institution.
Prof. Sukanta Bose Bhaskar Biswas
(Thesis Supervisor) (Ph.D. Candidate)
